title: An X-ray defender behind the attacker protects
rationale: mx-chs-006 plus the black chariot on g5, the single change. Protection is tested in the position that would arise after the capture, where the chasing rook no longer stands on e5, so the chariot's line through the chaser counts and g5c5 recaptures: Red's e6e5 attacks a protected cannon, no chase of an unprotected target is sustained across every Red move, and the repetition is neutral and merely claimable.
